model: TEMPUR-Ergo Smart Base (Ergo + Sleeptracker System, powered by Sleeptracker AI)
notes: Covers the TEMPUR-Ergo Smart adjustable base with the Sleeptracker system, in the sizes the manual lists (Twin Long to California King). The two 9 V batteries for the backup box are not included with the base.

gaps: The manual has no model number; the model name is from its cover. Its copyright line is 2019, which is not a production date.
The Power Ratings box does not name the power supply; it lists AC input and DC output, so it is put on the power supply the quick-reference diagram shows.
Head and foot massage motors are named in the manual but left out: no motor type is stated, and the only motor part type that fits would claim DC.
The base frame is left out: the manual calls it the metal structure of the base, with no tube or sheet section given.
The lift motors are called actuator lift motors in the warranty; no voltage, watts or actuator type is given, so no ratings are set.
The Smart Cable is listed with input and output ratings only; the manual does not say it holds a converter, so it is keyed as a cable, not a buck converter.
FCC IDs H8N-WLL6540 and 2AF2O-FPM20 are tied by the manual to the Sleeptracker system STS-40 / STS-40A, not to the base, so the record has no fcc field.
The chemistry of the 9 V and AAA batteries is not stated.
method: Tempur-Pedic TEMPUR-Ergo Smart Base owner's manual (Powered by Sleeptracker AI), PDF on assets-www.tempurpedic.com, read with research.js pdf; the English pages are PDF pages 5-16.

Printed page numbers: power ratings p.1, product ratings p.2, Sleeptracker specifications and FCC p.3-4, base overview p.5, quick reference p.6, remote p.7-8, pairing p.9, battery backup box p.10, troubleshooting p.11, warranty p.12.
The base overview and quick-reference diagrams were rendered and looked at to read the part labels.
No bot check, login or paywall on the manufacturer PDF.

comps.spec: Base power supply: input 100-240 V AC 50/60 Hz 2.0 A; output 29 V DC 2.0 A; 58 W rated

Control box under the base: takes the input power cord from the power supply and has connection ports for the head and foot motors (massage and lift). Has a button pressed twice for the alternate remote-pairing steps, and a green LED.

Head motor and foot motor that raise and lower the head and foot sections; the warranty calls them actuator lift motors. The manual limits them to about 2 minutes of use in any 18 minutes (about 10% duty cycle).
Two 9 V batteries for the emergency battery backup box, not included with the base; the manual says not to mix brand names.
comps.loc: Battery backup box, underneath the base

comps.spec: Three AAA batteries required to operate the remote control.
Sleeptracker Smart Cable, model STC-10: listed with input 29 V DC 100 mA and output 5 V DC, max 500 mA.

Sleeptracker Sleep Monitoring System, model STS-40 / STS-40A (one processor unit with one or two sensors): input 5 V DC 500 mA; Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n, 2.4 GHz band, 0.25 W Wi-Fi output. The manual says it contains transmitter module FCC ID H8N-WLL6540 or 2AF2O-FPM20.
Underbed LED lighting, switched on and off from the remote.
Sleeptracker sensors: one or two, depending on the size of system bought.

sources.title: TEMPUR-Ergo Smart Base (Powered by Sleeptracker AI) Owner's Manual, Tempur-Pedic, copyright 2019 (PDF)
